_readme: Known mainnet lock/type script code_hash values, keyed by family name. Entries with "verified": true are well-established public CKB constants (cross-check against https://github.com/nervosnetwork/rfcs/blob/master/rfcs/0024-ckb-genesis-script-list before relying on them for a committee-facing deliverable). Entries with "verified": false / code_hash null are placeholders -- fill in from your own CKB Explorer instance's known-script list or the CKB system-scripts repo before classify_lock_family() can recognize them. Do not guess a code_hash into this file; an entry that's wrong here will silently misclassify a lock family, and lock family is only ever meant to be behavioral CONTEXT (see Report.docx, section 9) -- never a human/bot/miner decision by itself.

omnilock.note: Fill in from your Explorer instance or the OmniLock RFC before use.

anyone_can_pay.note: Fill in from your Explorer instance or the ACP RFC before use.

cheque.note: Fill in from your Explorer instance before use.

pw_lock.note: Fill in if PW-Lock addresses are expected in your population.
